claims.claim: The paper reports classification results for the selected phonetic evidence on continuous Mandarin speech.
claims.limitations: Cohort, disorder labels, language, transcript quality, phoneme selection, and recording conditions limit clinical generalization; classification is not diagnosis.

claims.claim: The paper reports dataset resources and benchmark behavior for open-set deepfake source tracing and attribution.
claims.limitations: Generator coverage, perturbations, speakers, labels, and open-set split design bound the result; benchmark attribution is not courtroom-grade provenance.

claims.claim: The paper reports few-shot detection adaptation results against the tested baselines.
claims.limitations: Attack families, kernel choices, calibration, shots, and base detector limit generalization; uncertainty estimates are not automatically reliable under distribution shift.

claims.claim: The paper reports spoken dialogue-state-tracking gains from the transformed data.
claims.limitations: LLM prompt, domains, state schema, speech realization, annotation checks, and evaluation distribution limit the result; style conversion can silently change intent.

claims.claim: The paper reports high-quality neural coding results for the tested audio-visual conditions.
claims.limitations: Video quality, synchronization, speakers, bitrate, decoder, and missing-video behavior bound the claim; visual assistance can introduce privacy and spoofing risks.

claims.claim: The paper reports corpus additions, baseline models, and benchmark results for Fongbe-to-French speech translation.
claims.limitations: Corpus size, speakers, alignment, transcription, translation references, and split design bound generalization to Fongbe communities and other low-resource pairs.

claims.claim: The paper reports reduced hallucination behavior for the tested audio-aware models and synthesized negative-sample strategy.
claims.limitations: Negative-sample construction, audio quality, prompts, model family, and evaluation rubric limit the claim; abstention quality is not the same as factual clinical reliability.

claims.claim: The paper reports objective and perceptual results for zero-shot mono-to-binaural synthesis.
claims.limitations: Room and position range, speaker diversity, spatial labels, head-related filtering, and listening protocol bound generalization; stereo plausibility is not physical localization accuracy.
